revision_basis.diagnosis: Revision 0.9 falsified the assumption that generic reverse traversal of the first-pass D8 array exactly reproduces the frozen Pysheds catchment semantics for Quirio. The pre-registered >=0.995 Jaccard gate correctly failed and is not relaxed. Revision 0.10 returns to the exact Pysheds catchment call used by the frozen geometry generator, but performs it on the single already-created Grid/fdir instance instead of constructing and conditioning a redundant second native Grid. Weighted main-channel distance is then computed deterministically on the exact validated Pysheds catchment topology as the sum of unchanged 30 m orthogonal and sqrt(2)*30 m diagonal D8 links; this is mathematically the same weighted D8 path quantity and avoids invoking a second native distance kernel. No morphometric value was used to select or tune this correction.

exact_geometry_dem_reconstruction.hard_integrity_gate: regenerated DEM GeoTIFF SHA256 must exactly equal geometry_freeze.dem_utm_sha256 for every target

routing_semantics.other_five: exact Pysheds grid.catchment(x=containing-cell-center-x,y=containing-cell-center-y,fdir=same_grid_fdir,dirmap=(64,128,1,2,4,8,16,32),xytype='coordinate') on the binary-identical frozen geometry-generation DEM
routing_semantics.single_grid_rule: DEM conditioning, flowdir and exact Pysheds catchment use one Grid instance per target; no second Grid, no second DEM conditioning and no second flowdir computation
routing_semantics.alignment_gate: Jaccard(exact Pysheds catchment, frozen-polygon cell-center mask) >= 0.995 and frozen-polygon coverage >= 0.995

main_channel_distance.distance_algorithm: deterministic reverse traversal on the same immutable D8 fdir restricted to the exact Pysheds catchment
main_channel_distance.link_weights: 30 m for orthogonal D8 links and sqrt(2)*30 m for diagonal D8 links, derived from the exact projected DEM transform
main_channel_distance.selection: maximum finite distance among unchanged frozen-polygon center cells that are also in the exact Pysheds catchment

unchanged_metric_semantics.polygon_area_and_perimeter: exact frozen polygon projected to EPSG:32718
unchanged_metric_semantics.drainage_density: unchanged contributing-area threshold and in-polygon D8 link rule

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output is frozen by hash
read sealed outcomes before the allowed unblind
use metric values from a failed worker to select, tune, drop or rerun a target under different scientific semantics
relax the 0.995 catchment coverage or Jaccard gates
substitute generic reverse-D8 catchment membership for the exact Pysheds catchment semantics
move an outlet or alter/expand a frozen basin polygon
change DEM conditioning, slope algorithm, channel threshold or metric inclusion rule
accept a regenerated DEM whose binary GeoTIFF SHA256 differs from the frozen geometry-generation DEM hash
treat a worker crash, missing artifact or routing mismatch as zero, dry, inactive or scientifically usable
